nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Face and Body Lotion

avis.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen! For a mineral sunscreen, it has a lightweight feel. While it's not as weightless as a chemical sunscreen, it's much lighter and easier to wear than most mineral sunscreens I've tried. One of the main reasons I keep coming back to it is its clean ingredients, which give me peace of mind when using it on myself and my entire family. It applies well, feels comfortable throughout the day, and offers great protection. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a safer, family-friendly mineral sunscreen that doesn't feel heavy on the skin.

I tried using this sunscreen on my face. The only product i had put in prior was Vit C serum, which had dried down. I put this on and an hour later, it was still sticky and shiny. I had to wash it off and start over. I also put some on my arms and it was sticky there, too. Would not recommend. Rather pricey too!

So far this is my favorite sunscreen I'm not a fan of the greasy oily look, but you can combat that by using a finishing powder. typically I only do that for my nose like the T-Zone. I've used it on my face and my body. This is my go-to sunscreen for everyday use on my face. I wear it over my serum and moisturizer since it's the thickest of the 3 products. It didn't clog my pores.

avis.titre: Horribly burned, ineffective as a sunscreen.
avis.texte: I was hoping this sunscreen would work out for me since it appears to be marketed towards people with sensitive skin but I applied it heavily and still got a terrible sunburn. My skin looked burgundy. It was as if I had nothing on at all. Not only is it ineffective, but it's also increadibly greasy and sticky and pleasant to touch where applied.

Avene is the best. So gentle and moisturizing on your skin. I have a number of their products and this does not disappoint. In fact I prefer this on my face as it gives me a dewy glow and feels great. There is no smell and a small amount goes a long way. Rub it in and the zinc disappears leaving you with a youthful appearance. Spent the whole day at a concert and this Norwegian gal did not get burnt!
This sunscreen was greasy, grainy and left a white streaky finish. Disgusting!

I love this! For a completely mineral sunscreen with no tint, I'm super impressed. This is a great moisturizer and can totally be used as a single step. It does have a waxy sort of smell to it when you first apply but it doesn't linger- if you're someone who has to use all fragrance-free products because of eczema you probably already know exactly whatp I'm talking about. But again, the smell doesn't linger, it completely disappears. There is also a pretty strong white cast when you first apply, but after rubbing it in well and waiting for it to absorb (you should be waiting ~20 mins after applying sunscreen before you go outside anyway!) it completely disappears on my brown skin. (I'm about the skin tone of Parveen Kaur for reference lol.) I only use it on my body though, for two reasons: 1) I prefer tinted minerals on my face to help with hyperpigmentation, and 2) white casts are always more noticeable on the face in my opinion. But if I try it on my face I will report back! Overall, I find this super moisturizing and great for winter dryness and/or eczema prone skin. I like to apply it on my arms and legs, even in the winter when I'm covered up. Feels thick and soothing and leaves my skin soft. If you like a lightweight sunscreen that doesn't feel like body lotion, this is NOT for you. Especially in a humid climate, this might be too much. I also can't speak to the white cast for someone with a deeper skintone than mine. But for my skin type (brown, dry and sensitive, life

I am not one who is harsh on products and always give them the benefit of the doubt, but this one had an overpowering smell! I do not mind a heavy fragrance but this one was not pleasant. I would absolutely purchase again if there was a way to tone down those scents some! I did some reasearch and some people mentioned that it may be a scent from the minerals causing a weird smell rather than adding fragrance which can cause a reaction in some people. Who knows, but I do know I hold my breath everytime I put it on! :(

This has the least amount of whitecast of any mineral sunscreen ive tried and is one of the highest SPFs I have seen. The smell is not pleasent. But it goes away after a bit. I have asked my bf and he cannot smell it on my skin after the inital application.
This sunscreen is too white, has a scent to it its not bad but not for me im sure theres better sunscreens

I had buy this same product but it had a different packaging(it used to be orange) i loved it back then, because it keept my skin hydrated(super good for dry skin). This time the smell and consistency of formulation is way different, too liquidy, and i can learn to work with that… but the smell, it's just awful, i thought it was caducated but nope… If they could only take that smell away i would love this again!

avis.titre: It protects well but isn't comfortable to wear
avis.texte: I'm not sure how they can market it as "not greasy" when even after an hour of application it is still quite greasy on the face and body. That being said, it does a great job protecting from burning and tanning, and despite it's greasiness it's held up for many hours in sweltering heat and humidity. I wore a thick layer to the theme park, set it on the face with SPF powder, and throughout the day dabbed the sweat off with face tissue. No burns or tanning. Not an everyday wear SPF but good for when you expect to be out in the heat/sun for a time.

avis.titre: White cast not for olive/melanin skin
avis.texte: White cast on face :/ This is not for melanin skin at all. Im olive/medium tan, kund of like jessica albas skin tone, im not even that dark and this left a obvious white cast, my face had that purple hue, I looked awful. and the consistency is very thick, goopy and sticky and had this weird smell. I guess this would be fine to use for the body if you are not easily bothered by consistency or smell . I prefer a sunscreen that feels like its not there

So i was in the market to looking into some new susncreens. I was very interested in this brand because its suited for sensitive skin. I decided on this SPF 50 cream. But the moment i felt it in my hands it was little thick to blend. I could tell by just feeling it on my face and seeing it move around that it was going to leave a noticeable residue. The scent was strong and gross. I wanna say it smelled like feet. So i returned it immediately.

avis.titre: Does the job but messy SPF
avis.texte: Good sun screen but not a fan of how heavy it is. You have to thoroughly wash your hands after applying so I have to bring towels or wipes to clean my hands off if I use this on the go at the beach for example. Because my hands will be layered with a thick grease. It feels pretty light weight considering how thick/oozy the lotion comes out. Definitely does its job though! I'm just a neat freak. It comes out VERY white on the skin so be sure to rub it all in. So white that it almost gives a purple hue on tanner skin. Also does not smell great at all. Fragrance free but really does not have a sunscreen pleasant scent. I use a different one of my face for this reason.

avis.titre: the BEST. great for acne prone skin and scars.
avis.texte: have tried so many different face sunscreens. this is the BEST. and has pretty much cured my hormonal acne breakouts and scars. seriously. i'm so grateful. please keep making this.
I'm on to my second tube of this mineral sunscreen. I use it on my body only, and it rubs in soft and easy, and dries clear. It also moisturizes my skin and makes it feel and look great. Love it!

avis.titre: Not too thick rubs in without any whiteness
avis.texte: Think this is a great sunscreen. Doesn't leave a white layer on your skin. Rubs in easy while protecting your skin.

avis.titre: Great for body not for face
avis.texte: Great for body and neck but not for face is too Greasy for the face.
I'm very disappointed, this is definitely Not Avene. The smell is ghastly and the texture is very dense much more the original Avene .
I am obsessed with this brand. I have gotten my mom and daughters to switch over too, and they love it.

Smells awful but wears nicely with no white cast on fairer skin, however for deeper skin it would likely be unsuitable. You get a great amount for the price compared to equivalents from Supergoop, LRP, RoC, and others.
This was an awful sunscreen. It has white cast and was incredibly thick. I ended up having to wash it off. It was sticky and starting to burn.
Quality product, but it's a very heavy formula for the face. Going forward, will probably use it on other parts of the body but use something lighter for the face.

I have very oily acne prone skin so finding a sunscreen that is comfortable and effective at protection is difficult. This sunscreen is horrible. It's extremely greasy to the point where I look like I'm sweating and because it doesn't dry down, my skin is sticky and my hair will stick onto areas like the sides of the face and neck (think of hair getting stuck on goopy lipgloss). Despite being a runny lotion, I find the formula very heavy on the skin to the point where it clogged my pores leading to breakouts and bumps throughout my face. Be careful when applying/reapplying this around your neck as it will leave a white sticky residue on the collar of your shirt although it does come off when washing. No yellow or brown stains were left behind on my clothes though. I have horizontal neck lines and throughout the day product would settle into them so I have to constantly be blending my neck; this also applies to my eyelids making it look like I have two white lines. Reapplication feels like adding a heavy greasy layer on the skin again, something that I did not enjoy doing even though I blotted away excess oils and product before reapplying. On the positive side, this sunscreen despite being a mineral formula, doesn't leave a clownish white cast on my medium skin tone. I use two fingers length of product (one for face, one for neck). Although there is a slight white cast upon application, by rubbing and patting the product in, the cast does disappear but that doesn't mean the g

I can't believe this is an Avène product. All their products are usually light, fresh, airy, & pleasant. THIS ONE SMELLS TERRIBLE. I CAN't stand it. Smells old, musty, almost stale like & chemically. Runny consistency. I'm so DISAPPOINTED. I looked up reviews and I see I'm not the only one. (Thought maybe I got a bad bottle). Not sure what happened with this one.

I am a huge Avene fan (I have used their Xeracalm line for a long time) but I found this sunscreen hard to rub in, at least on my skin. This is typical with mineral sunscreens, but I was hopeful that this one would be easier. The smell is strong but it's great for sensitive skin.

I use this sunscreen for exercise and the white cast is extremely messy at first. I am tan and it took me a hard time to blend it on my skin, I ended up looking greasy for 30 minutes. It look very nice after that tho, it has a silky finish at the end. I like this product because it offers a good protection and didn't burned my eyes but is not very practical and even less if you need to reapply it. Also the smell is strong at the beginning.

avis.titre: Not what I had in mind....
avis.texte: This new formula is heavy, greasy feeling and leaves a bit of a white cast. It also has a weird smell.

I used this new mineral sunscreen for about a month - daily - and had been enjoying it. No white cast, dewy complexion, moisturizing feel. Then this past week the Northeast was hit with a heatwave. During 90+ degree temps, I was sweating quite a bit. I unfortunately discovered that for some reason, my sweat and this sunscreen don't seem to mix and I was having an allergic reaction. So, I had to suspend my use. I'll resume using it when the temperature drops below 70 degrees just to finish up the tube. I really like it, but since I can't wear it during peak heat without having a reaction, it doesn't make sense to repurchase. I need something that can be worn all year round.

I'm unhappy with the performance of the sunscreen. Product is watery; in fact, a liquid leaks out of the cover and is the first thing to hit my palm. It also has a very "stale" smell which is quite strong and unpleasant. I normally love Avene but this product is not for me.

avis.titre: Flawless performance -- an absolute winner for sun-sensit...
avis.texte: I recently returned from a field mission to multiple sub-Saharan countries. I applied this sunscreen several times a day on every inch of my skin that might be exposed to the sun, including my whole face and around my eyes. After 9 weeks in the field, my highly sensitive skin showed absolutely no signs of sunburn, irritation or dryness. Furthermore, its mineral formula is not harmful to the environment, which is also very important to me. Perfect!! I do use the Mineral Multi Defense Fluid on my face when I'm back at home as it seems to work better under my make-up, and continue to use the Face & Body Lotion everywhere else. NOTE TO AVENE: Please, please, make a lighter shade of the Tinted Compact. The lightest shade currently available (Beige) is still too dark for me and everyone else in my family. I've noticed that several other customers are requesting it too!!

My go-to when I need the most serious protection! This keeps my pale, dry, and delicate skin safe in the most intense Sun locations like the tropics, snorkeling, surfing, and sailing. It is very moisturizing, which I love. It applies slightly pale, then quickly disappears so my skin tone looks normal and glowing.
Unlike most mineral sunscreens, this doesn't leave a white cast and isn't drying. However, it's pretty greasy even for my dry skin. I have to powder it down.

My skin is ultra sensitive and every other sunscreen has caused a rash believe me I've tried them all! So far this one is great! A bit of white cast but quickly disappears, there is a strange odor as with all Avene sunscreens but that too fades. A little goes a long way! I love that it is for face and body! Thanks for another awesome product Avene!

This may be the best body sunscreen I've ever used. The texture is rich. The lotion is quickly absorbed by my skin. The cast, which is faint to begin with, disappears in a matter of seconds. And no fragrance! I still prefer the Mineral Multi-Defense Sunscreen Fluid for my face, but I love this new lotion for everywhere else.
Didn't irritate my skin. Didn't leave a white cast but wish formula was more absorbent.

I got this because the picture looked somewhat clear and sounded safe for skin. This is terrible. Its thick white and leaves a nasty white coating on skin and smells/feels terrible. Its waxy and horrible.

I previously used the face only mineral sunscreen and I was hoping this would be as good but I found it to be really greasy. No matter how long I leave it to soak in I'm left with extremely shiny face. I have extremely sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate which is great. It just just feels really thick and slimy and I hate applying it all over my body.

I got this sunscreen in a gift with purchase and tried it immediately. I was excited because usually (unfortunately) many chemical sunscreens break me out and this didnt have anything but zinc oxide. It was a little heavy and took a little longer to blend out than others ive used but after blending it was definitely a dewy sunscreen. It wore well under my minimal makeup but was a little more dewy than i usually like.
Very greasy Not suitable for melanated skin, if apply 2 finger length takes > 1 min yo blend and you end up looking like a glazed donut. White cast
This sunscreen is pretty greasy on my face, but sinks better onto the whole body. Also it does leave a white cast.
My face was fine. I tried this sunscreen and it was super heavy, greasy and white undertone which I didn't like :(

The hunt for a mineral sunscreen with no white cast is finally over! I took a chance ordering this without reviews and it's great! It looks white a first, but within a minute it's clear and feels hydrating. The price isn't bad for the amount of you get.
I use this on my face when I plan to wear a mineral powder foundation as it is a bit on the oily side. But it is great as a daily sunscreen and moisturizer on my old arms in Texas sun.
It is a bit heavy and takes time to rub in. I have decided to go back to the La Roche-Posay body sunscreen.

I learned about these products at my dermatologist office and they encouraged me to try a cream for after the sunlamp treatment (or blue light not sure what it was called) at any rate it was so good that I though I should buy stock in your company. As far as the sunscreen I haven't used it enough yet to comment.
Very unhappy with this sunscreen. It doesn't rub in and leaves a whiteish tint to the skin. Better off with the EltaMD zinc oxide sunscreen which doesn't leave your skin white!

I had a recent breakout of eczema (sun sensitivity) and I remembered my dermatologist recommending Avène before prescribing topical meds. The XeraCalm has helped so much and the sunscreen products are gentle on the skin and incredibly effective.

Had to take one star away for the smell. Absolutely the best sunblock Ive ever used on my face . It goes on like a dream after my moisturizer , has a slight whitish cast to it at first but by the time it soaks in it subtlety has evened put my skin tone and looks great with or with out make up. It's thick and slightly sticky and the " no scent" smell is not great but I'll put up with that for the all day protection it affords me. Unlike other sunblocks I have used it doesn't irritate my skin or need reapplying after all day hiking . I haven't tried it in the water yet but I'm sure it will perform just as well

I wanted to like this so much but it has been leaking out of the cap no matter what i do and getting everywhere. it's also potentially irritating my skin which surprised me. the mineral UV for face is a bit thinner feeling and I like that one a lot so I was disappointed I can't experience that for the rest of my body.

This sunscreen is the absolute best! A little goes a very long way and it doesn't leave a white cast. It spreads easily. This is going to become our new family favorite. This is great for day at the pool or the beach. Please don't ever discontinue this!
Excellent for the face. Non-greasy, quick absorbing, very effective. Perfect for very sensitive skin.
I love almost every Avene product I've ever tried, but this one is a dud. It stays on the skin surface and is really sticky. Not what I was looking for. Luckily, it can be returned.

Just used this today and am very happy with it. I used on my neck and body and found it very easy to rub in and no white cast at all. (I'm very fair though.). Felt very nice on my hyper sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Love it! Please don't change anything!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is perfect and free of fragrance, hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. I have been looking for a sunscreen free of those things because they bother my skin. I love this sunscren. It looks great under makeup too! Please do not change a thing! Great job!
